Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Csaba Pálinkás lived longer than Henry Scheffé" based on the faulty logic that since Csaba died in 2004 and Henry died in 1977, Csaba must have lived longer. This ignores the fact that Csaba was born in 1959 and Henry was born in 1907. The correct calculation shows Henry lived approximately 70 years (1907-1977) while Csaba lived approximately 45 years (1959-2004). The Planner failed to perform the basic arithmetic comparison of lifespans and instead relied on a misleading proxy of death year without accounting for the significant difference in birth years.
